scope_note: Eastward Subarctic/Aleutian flow convention in Favorite (1967), Figure 27, investigated at 160 W. OSW chooses a 46-51 N peak-search window around the regional schematic reach, not observed current edges. Surface peaks may be eddies or North Pacific exchange; no cold-water property gate or historical upper-1000 m identity transfer. Westward Alaskan Stream and Bering-side North Slope Current remain separate. Local monthly-mean component spans, not flow-normal widths, whole-current dimensions or a seasonal footprint.
layer: Satellite-derived near-surface product with nominal 15 m coordinate; not a direct 15 m instrument section or depth-resolved velocity.
time_convention: 72 nominal five-day 2013 archive samples, with four six-day gaps, January 1 through December 26. One year, not climatology or adequate evidence for annual extrema.
